title: Five Human Needs Running Through the Field
dek: Under every program, credential and grant around The Labs is a person who needs something. We read the 50 organizations on our field map for what that is, set it beside what alumni and organizers told us, and found four frames to try before the Nov 14 vote.
cover_alt: Five coloured lines run down the page, one for each human need: Mattering, Coherence, Not Alone, Belonging, Believing I Can. Each row is an organization, with a station on every line whose need it reaches for.
